source: lab (real Orbbec Femto Mega RGB recording; background replaced by a synthetic blue-to-white gradient with SAM2 - watermark 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' bottom right)
frame_time: t = frame / 24 (frame 0 at t = 0, last frame 48 at t = 2.0 s)

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift of a background patch vs frame 0 < 0.1 px in every frame)

intrinsics_from_benchmark_convention.note: given by the benchmark for this camera; not measured here

camera.back_projection: ray = ((u-640)/763, (v-360)/763, 1); 3D centre = depth_info * ray/|ray| (depth_info = Euclidean distance camera->object centre)
camera.perspective_cues: none in the background (synthetic gradient replaces floor/walls; no ground plane, horizon or markings). Depth cues are only the apparent sizes of the balls and people. Both balls appear to move on/near the floor between the two people; the rear person's planted shoes are at image y ~ 322, the front person's shoes at y ~ 700-720.
camera.frame_timing_anomaly: frames 12 and 36 differ from their predecessors about twice as much as other frames and the basketball's image step doubles there (11->12: 29 px, 35->36: 26 px vs ~13 px), so a source frame was probably dropped before frame 12 and before frame 36. Times in the tracks are nominal frame/24.

objects.name: soccer_ball
objects.desc: white football with black pentagons; starts at the front_person's right foot at bottom centre-left
objects.reference_point: centre of a circle fitted to the ball outline

rest_position_frames_0_10.note: bottom of ball touches the bottom image edge (y~720)

objects.apparent_size: diameter 76 px at rest (frames 0-10) -> shrinks to ~58-59 px at frames 24-26 (moving away) -> grows slowly to ~64 px by frame 48 (comes back toward the camera after the contact with the basketball). Per-frame radius noise ~ +-1.5 px; use radius_px_med5.

objects.name: basketball
objects.desc: orange basketball; starts at the rear_person's feet (upper right)
objects.reference_point: centre of a circle fitted to the orange outline
objects.apparent_size: diameter 52.8 px at rest -> grows steadily to ~72 px at frame 48 (approaching the camera).

objects.name: front_person
objects.desc: person nearest the camera at the left: long brown hair (face blurred), dark grey T-shirt, black trousers, white shoes; kicks the soccer ball, later bends and catches the basketball
objects.visible_frames: 0-48 (always cut by the bottom image edge; left edge at x=0 in frames ~11-33; appears strongly tilted because of the close range)
objects.reference_point: mask bbox centre and mask centroid (pelvis not directly visible as a point; full body not in frame)

objects.name: rear_person
objects.desc: person far from the camera at the upper right: light grey/white top, dark blue-grey baggy trousers, white sneakers, black watch on left wrist; head cut off by the top image edge; kicks the basketball
objects.visible_frames: 0-48 (always cut by the top image edge: only from the chest down is visible)
objects.reference_point: mask bbox centre and mask centroid (truncated body)
objects.static_extent: visible part from y=0 to shoe soles y~322 (323 px tall) throughout; bbox width 98-166 px depending on leg pose; feet stay at y~320 (does not walk away)

objects.name: watermark
objects.desc: grey text box 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo'

events.name: soccer_ball_at_rest
events.note: image motion < 2 px/frame; front_person's kicking shoe next to it

events.name: basketball_at_rest
events.note: image motion < 0.5 px/frame; rear_person's kicking shoe reaches it at frames 10-12

events.name: soccer_ball_kicked_starts_moving
events.note: first displacement 7 px at frame 11, then 76 px 11->12 (kick + probable dropped frame), ~27 px/frame at 13-14, decelerating in the image afterwards

events.name: basketball_kicked_starts_moving
events.note: last rest frame 11; 29 px step 11->12 (probable dropped frame), then ~13-20 px/frame

events.name: balls_overlap_in_image_and_probable_collision
events.note: centre distance 57.9/44.2/52.0/63.7 px vs sum of radii ~59-60 px at frames 24/25/26/27; the soccer ball is in front (it hides the lower right of the basketball). At frame 25 the soccer ball's image y-motion reverses (up -> down) and its apparent size stops shrinking and starts growing, i.e. it is deflected back toward the camera; the basketball's downward image step drops from ~8 to ~4-5 px/frame. Best estimate of contact: frame 25 (t=1.042 s).

events.name: front_person_bends_to_catch
events.note: front_person turns/bends and reaches down with the right hand

events.name: hand_contacts_basketball
events.note: hand first overlaps the ball at 45-46, covers it at 47-48; ball centre still moving ~13 px/frame to frame 48 (catch not finished at video end)

files.tracks/soccer_ball.csv: per frame: cx, cy, radius (circle fit), bbox of fitted circle, mask extents, occlusion flag + note
files.tracks/front_person.csv: per frame: bbox, bbox centre, mask centroid, PCA main-axis length/width/angle, area, cut_by_frame_edge
